details: Bitcoin surged over 4% in the last 24 hours, climbing past $78,000 and breaking key resistance levels. This rally has pushed major institutional portfolios back into profit and strengthened a bullish technical setup, with analysts eyeing the $80,000 mark.
title: Bitcoin Breaks $78K Amid Bullish Momentum

details: Lawmakers in Washington are reportedly close to a final agreement on the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act. This bill aims to establish a comprehensive framework for crypto regulation in the United States, defining jurisdictional boundaries between the SEC and CFTC and clarifying rules for various digital assets, including tokens, stablecoins, and decentralized finance (DeFi) platforms.
title: US Crypto Legislation Nears Finish Line

details: Ethereum experienced a notable 6% daily surge, successfully breaking above a long-term descending channel on its daily chart. The cryptocurrency is now testing its 100-day moving average near $2,460. This technical breakout suggests renewed bullish momentum, with the next major resistance level anticipated around $2,800.
title: Ethereum Surges 6%, Breaks Key Resistance
